verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents 'Resolve', a built-in AI agent that takes a production error and produces a reviewable pull request. That is a real form of delegating work to an in-product AI assistant. The evidence is a single first-party doc line, and it covers only one narrow task type (error-to-PR fix). Missing for 10: delegation of a broader range of tasks (triage, querying, configuration), detail on how users invoke and steer the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Resolve works as described.
